story.title: Rocky,Lucy and Ginger
paragraphs_en: Me and my friend Rocky,Lucy and Ginger Me and my friend Emannuel ( Emu) were just walking around our society one day. We found three small kittens below three scooters in the parking lot. No one was taking care of them. So we both decided to take care of them.

After a few weeks, my friend Kartik disturbed us while playing in the club house of the society. Then he decided to show something to us.We went with him and saw our three little kittens.One was black and white, second one was brown and white and third one was black, brown and white.We named them as Rocky, Lucy and Ginger.

Ginger always likes to eat and play with his other siblings.Lucy likes to climb and sleep in our society and Rocky always pays attention to us and listens to what we say. And Rocky is my favourite among three. He never misunderstood us. We all were enjoying each other's company. We had fun together during our summer holidays.

When my school started, before leaving for school, I looked at the three kittens and said bye to them.They lovingly looked at me. I missed them during my school hours and after coming back from school and I played with them. My friend Aryan fed them multigrain chips and some milk. Whenever we saw them, Emu started singing the songs like Believer and Thunder, and all of the kittens started listening to the songs very carefu lly

he songs very carefu lly We started spending minutes, hours, days with them. The worst thing was after a few weeks, the watchman uncle of the Oxford building called some cat catchers to catch them. All of us didn’t want kittens to go away from us because they are as close as our siblings to us .Since I and Emu are such close friends of the kittens, we treated them as our siblings. That’s why we were worried when we heard about it

But unfortunately, the day came and they are caught by catcatchers.We felt devastated and lost them permanently.We even didn’t know if they would come back again. But still they come to me in my dreams. If they would come back, I would like to say the words as below: welcome back my friends, you are still a part of my family.

sentences.text_en: I missed them during my school hours and after coming back from school and I played with them.

sentences.text_en: he songs very carefu lly We started spending minutes, hours, days with them.
sentences.text_vi: Chúng mình bắt đầu dành hàng phút, hàng giờ, hàng ngày ở bên chúng.

sentences.text_en: The worst thing was after a few weeks, the watchman uncle of the Oxford building called some cat catchers to catch them.
sentences.text_vi: Điều tồi tệ nhất là vài tuần sau, chú bảo vệ của tòa nhà Oxford đã gọi người bắt mèo đến để bắt chúng đi.

sentences.text_en: All of us didn’t want kittens to go away from us because they are as close as our siblings to us .Since I and Emu are such close friends of the kittens, we treated them as our siblings.
sentences.text_vi: Tất cả chúng mình đều không muốn mèo con rời xa vì chúng thân thiết như anh chị em ruột của chúng mình vậy. Vì mình và Emu là bạn thân của các chú mèo con, chúng mình coi chúng như anh chị em ruột.

sentences.text_en: That’s why we were worried when we heard about it
sentences.text_vi: Đó là lý do tại sao chúng mình rất lo lắng khi nghe tin này.

sentences.text_en: But unfortunately, the day came and they are caught by catcatchers.We felt devastated and lost them permanently.We even didn’t know if they would come back again.
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng thật không may, ngày đó đã đến và chúng bị những người bắt mèo bắt đi. Chúng mình cảm thấy rất đau lòng và mất chúng vĩnh viễn. Chúng mình thậm chí không biết liệu chúng có quay lại nữa không.

sentences.text_en: But still they come to me in my dreams.
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng chúng vẫn đến với mình trong những giấc mơ.

sentences.text_en: If they would come back, I would like to say the words as below: welcome back my friends, you are still a part of my family.
sentences.text_vi: Nếu chúng quay lại, mình muốn nói những lời này: chào mừng các bạn trở về, các bạn vẫn là một phần của gia đình mình.

items.text_en: Me and my friend Rocky,Lucy and Ginger Me and my friend Emannuel ( Emu) were just walking around our society one day.

No one was taking care of them.
So we both decided to take care of them.
After a few weeks, my friend Kartik disturbed us while playing in the club house of the society.

Then he decided to show something to us.We went with him and saw our three little kittens.One was black and white, second one was brown and white and third one was black, brown and white.We named them as Rocky, Lucy and Ginger.
Ginger always likes to eat and play with his other siblings.Lucy likes to climb and sleep in our society and Rocky always pays attention to us and listens to what we say.
And Rocky is my favourite among three.
He never misunderstood us.
We all were enjoying each other's company.
We had fun together during our summer holidays.
When my school started, before leaving for school, I looked at the three kittens and said bye to them.They lovingly looked at me.
I missed them during my school hours and after coming back from school and I played with them.
My friend Aryan fed them multigrain chips and some milk.
Whenever we saw them, Emu started singing the songs like Believer and Thunder, and all of the kittens started listening to the songs very carefu lly
